articles.title: Tensions flare as judge declines to remove juror in Lindsay Clancy trial
articles.description: The defence lawyer is upset after the judge decides not to remove a holdout in the triple murder case.

articles.title: Argentine leader says oil firms working off Falklands face sanctions
articles.description: Javier Milei reiterates his country's claim on the British overseas territory, saying the "winds of change" favour it.

articles.title: US investigating if missile hit Iran wedding, Vance says
articles.description: The Iranian Red Crescent Society (IRCS) said shrapnel from a missile hit the ceremony and killed four people on Tuesday.

articles.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
articles.description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

articles.title: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say
articles.description: Al-Mughayyir's council says they were trying to stop settlers stealing sheep, but the Israeli military says they threw stones at its troops.

articles.title: Embattled Spanish PM insists there were no prior warnings before Ceuta crisis
articles.description: Pedro Sánchez tells parliament it is absurd to think the government knew and did nothing, after thousands join protests in Spanish cities.

articles.title: Two people arrested by German police over alleged arson attack on defence firm
articles.description: Germany is investigating a suspected arson attack outside a defence firm in Munich, days after two sabotage attempts on the country's power grid.
